subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps — Finovate Bank
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@finovatebank.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: Finovate Bank discovery — stakeholder mapping & next steps

Team,

Quick recap from my call with Liam (Finovate Bank) this morning. High-level: they like Redwood's latency/cost profile and the idea of a hybrid private deployment for regulated workloads, but the buying process is multi-threaded and will take 6-10 weeks if we move fast. Key bullets: 

- Economic buyer: likely Sarah Boone (SVP, Procurement) — Liam will intro once we have the commercial framework (SOW/pricing ranges).
- Security/legal: Nathan Price (CISO) will need SOC 2 + encryption/KMS details and a short architecture diagram for on-prem option.
- Procurement: standard vendor questionnaire; they also require up-to-date SOC 2 report and subprocessor list before POC.
- Decision criteria: predictable latency, data residency controls, and cost per 1M tokens under committed capacity.

Liam is our champion and wants internal talking points to help sell this up. He asked for: 
1) a one-pager with ROI talk tracks + 3 example TCO scenarios (small POC, mid pilot, enterprise commit)
2) a short slide or diagram explaining Private deployment + KMS flow they can show to security
3) a suggested mutual action plan (timeline + milestones) to share with procurement

I'm attaching my first-pass stakeholder map (redwood_stakeholder_map_v1.xlsx) and a stubbed ROI talk track doc (roi-talk-tracks.pdf). Can you both review and add any missing asks from security/procurement?

Next actions I want to align on:
- Marcus: can you draft the ROI 1-pager + TCO scenarios by EOD Friday?
- Rachel: can you pull the typical procurement checklist and confirm what evidence (SOC2, pen test, subprocessors) we should surface now vs. later?
- I'll follow up with Liam to schedule a 30-min prep call next week to arm him.

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: Finovate Bank discovery — stakeholder mapping & next steps

Thanks Marissa — good capture. A few quick notes from an enablement / commercial POV: 

- I'll build the ROI one-pager and include three scenarios (POC: 100k tokens/day, Pilot: 1M tokens/day, Commit: 5M tokens/day) with monthly cost delta vs. their current hosted provider + estimated latency gains.
- I'll include talk tracks tailored to their finance audience (savings from batching & KV caching, predictable committed pricing, and cost-safety nets for overage).
- For economic buyer framing: recommend we open with a range (list price + committed discount band) rather than firm numbers — keeps flexibility until procurement sees SOC2.

Security asks I have for Rachel: what is the expected SLA baseline procurement will want (uptime & latency SLOs)? Do we have a one-page KMS/architecture diagram we can share? If not, I can sketch a simple flow for the private deployment.

I'll aim to send the draft ROI doc and TCO table by EOD Friday.

Attachment: ROI-talk-tracks.pdf (application/pdf, 95KB)

--
Marcus Lin
Solution Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Post-call recap: Finovate Bank discovery — stakeholder mapping & next steps

Marissa / Marcus —

Quick procurement & security checklist based on similar mid-market banks we've worked with: 

Procurement evidence typically required up front:
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (or SOC 2 readiness + timeline)
- Subprocessor list + data flow diagram
- Standard DPA + redline notes (they will often push on data residency clauses)
- Basic insurance certs (cyber liability)

Security team (CISO) will ask for:
- Architecture diagram for Private deployment (KMS/HSM flow).
- Encryption-at-rest and in-transit details (algorithms, KMS provider options).
- Pen test timelines and known remediation backlog.

SLA notes: procurement usually asks for 99.9% uptime for production and a 95th latency target for 95th percentile in their SLA template. We can offer commercial SLA on Dedicated but will need legal signoff for Private deployments.

I don't have a ready-drawn KMS diagram — I'll coordinate with infra docs but Marcus, feel free to sketch and I'll clean up. Also, I'll upload the standard procurement checklist and a redlineable DPA to Drive and share link.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/finovate-stakeholder-map
DocuSign sample (procurement form): https://www.docusign.com/sign?env=prod&docId=FF-998271

Rachel
